senses.gloss: (b. h.) pr. n. Senir, a portion of Mount Hermon.
units: <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 4:8:3">Cant. R. to IV, 8</cite> [read:] <he>מה זה הש̇נ̇י̇ר̇ ש̇ונא את הנ̇י̇ר̇ ולא נזרע אלא פעם אחד כך וכ׳</he> as Mount Senir hates the plough and can be sown only once, so was Isaac &c.
<cite ref="Chullin 60b:14">Ḥull. 60ᵇ</cite> <he>ש׳ ושריון מהרי וכ׳</he> Senir and Sirion belong to the mountains of Palestine; a. e.
